scripts.dev:agent: conda run -n contextlens --no-capture-output sh -c 'cd agent && set -a && source ./.env && set +a && langgraph dev --port ${LANGGRAPH_PORT:-2026}'
scripts.setup:agent: conda run -n contextlens --no-capture-output python -m pip install -e ./agent
scripts.reset:memory-db: rm -f ./agent/data/memory.sqlite3 && PYTHONPATH=./agent python3 -c "from src.memory.repository import ensure_memory_store; ensure_memory_store()"
scripts.reset:demo: conda run -n contextlens python scripts/demo.py reset
scripts.test:agent: PYTHONPATH=agent conda run -n contextlens python -m unittest discover -s agent/tests -v
